what: Job A, round 3: each BORG run's logged dollars split into worker calls (the item calls for the 200 emails) and planner calls (plan, re_plan and compose).
source: bench/results/2026_11_19/dbs/A_borg_cloud_N.db (git-ignored, kept locally), table logs, rows with dollars not null
method: worker_dollars = sum(dollars) where event_type = 'model_call'; planner_compose_dollars = sum(dollars) where event_type = 'orchestrator_decision' (modes plan, re_plan, compose); planner_compose_share = planner_compose_dollars / (worker_dollars + planner_compose_dollars). logged_dollars equals the result file's cost_dollars on every run.
written: 2026-11-19, for the README section 'Where it pays and where it does not' (planner ruling 43); figures read from the run databases, nothing re-run
